pages.text:
Week 3 — DNS

name -> IP address

Hierarchy: root, top-level domain (TLD), authoritative server

Resolution steps for www.example.org:
1. Stub resolver asks the recursive resolver
2. Recursive resolver asks a root server -> referral to .org TLD server
3. TLD server -> referral to authoritative server for example.org
4. Authoritative server -> answer: the IP address

Caching: answers are cached for their TTL

Record types: A (IPv4 address), AAAA (IPv6 address), CNAME (alias), MX (mail server)

required_facts.fact: resolution walks root, then TLD, then authoritative server through referrals
the stub resolver asks the recursive resolver
answers are cached for their TTL
A is IPv4, AAAA is IPv6, CNAME is alias, MX is mail
